verses.sanskrit:
ब्राह्मण्युवाच।
              न सन्तापस्त्वया कार्यः प्राकृतेनेव कर्हिचित्। न हि सन्तापकालोऽयं वैद्यस्य तव विद्यते॥१॥
verses.english: The Brahmani said: You should not grieve like ordinary men. This is not the time for lamentation. You are learned.

verses.sanskrit: अवश्यं निधनं सर्वैर्गन्तव्यमिह मानवैः। अवश्यभाविन्यर्थे वै संतापो नेह विद्यते॥२॥
verses.english: All men must die. None should grieve for that which is inevitable.

verses.sanskrit: भार्या पुत्रोऽथ दुहिता सर्वमात्मार्थमिष्यते। व्यथां जहि सुबुद्ध्या त्वं स्वयं यास्यामि तत्र च॥३॥
verses.english: Man desires son, daughter and wife for himself. Therefore abandon grief, for you are greatly intelligent; I shall myself go there. It is the highest and eternal duty of women, namely to sacrifice their lives and to seek the good of their husbands.

verses.sanskrit: एतद्धि परमं नार्याः कार्यं लोके सनातनम्। प्राणानपि परित्यज्य यद्भर्तुर्हितमाचरेत्॥४॥
तच्च तत्र कृतं कर्म तवापीदं सुखावहम्। भवत्यमुत्र चाक्षय्यं लोकेऽस्मिंश्च यशस्करम्॥५॥
verses.english: Such an act done by me will give you pleasure; it will (also) bring me fame in this world and eternal bliss hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: एष चैव गुरुर्धर्मो यं प्रवक्ष्याम्यहं तव। अर्थश्च तव धर्मश्च भूयानत्र प्रदृश्यते॥६॥
verses.english: What I speak to you is the highest virtue. You can acquire by it (by my sacrificing myself) both virtue and profit.

verses.sanskrit: यदर्थमिष्यते भार्या प्राप्तःसोऽर्थस्त्वया मयि। कन्या चैका कुमारश्च कृताहमनृणा त्वया॥७॥
verses.english: The object for which one desires a wife has already been achieved by you from me. I have borne you a daughter and a son, by which I have been freed from the debt I owe you.

verses.sanskrit: समर्थः पोषणे चासि सुतयो रक्षणे तथा। न त्वहं सुतयोः शक्ता तथा रक्षणपोषणे॥८॥
verses.english: You are able to support and protect your children. I cannot support and protect the children as you can (do it).

verses.sanskrit: मम हि त्वद्विहीनायाः सर्वप्राणधनेश्वर। कथं स्यातां सुतौ बालौ भरेयं च कथं त्वहम्॥९॥
verses.english: You are my life, wealth and lord; having been abandoned by you, how these children to tender years and how myself, can live?

verses.sanskrit: कथं हि विधवाऽनाथा बालपुत्रा विना त्वया। मिथुनं जीवयिष्यामि स्थिता साधुगते पथि॥१०॥
verses.english: Being a helpless widow with two children of tender years depending on me how shall I be able to live leading my life in the path of virtue.

verses.sanskrit: अहं कृतावलिप्तैश्च प्रार्थ्यमानामिमां सुताम्। अयुक्तैस्तव संबन्धे कथं शक्ष्यामि रक्षितुम्॥११॥
verses.english: How shall I be able to protect the girl, if your this daughter is solicited by dishonourable and vain persons, unworthy of contracting an alliance with you?

verses.sanskrit: उत्सृष्टमामिषं भूमौ प्रार्थयन्ति यथा खगाः। प्रार्थयन्ति जनाः सर्वे पतिहीनां तथा स्त्रियम्॥१२॥
verses.english: As birds eagerly seek with avidity for the piece of) meat thrown on the ground, so men solicit women who have lost their husbands. O best of the twice-born, being solicited by wicked men, I might waver and I might not be able to keep myself on the path of virtue.
verses.bhavadeepa: अहंकृताः गर्विताः अवलिप्ताः कलङ्किताः ‘अवलेपस्तु गर्वैस्याल्लेपने दूषणेऽपि च’ इति मेदिनी ॥११॥

verses.sanskrit: साऽहं विचाल्यमाना वै प्रार्थ्यमाना दुरात्मभिः। स्थातुं पथि न शक्ष्यामि सज्जनेष्टे द्विजोत्तम॥१३॥
कथं तव कुलस्यैकमिमं बालमनागसम्। पितृपैतामहे मार्गे नियोक्तुमहमुत्सहे॥१४॥
verses.english: How shall I be able to place this only daughter of your house, this innocent girl, in the (virtuous) way in which her ancestors have always walked?

verses.sanskrit: कथं शक्ष्यामि बालेऽस्मिन्गुणानाधातुमीप्सितान्। अनाथे सर्वतो लुप्ते यथा त्वं धर्मदर्शिवान्॥१५॥
verses.english: How shall I be able to teach this child (your son) every desirable accomplishment to make him as virtuous as yourself in that time of want I shall be helpless (without you)?

verses.sanskrit: इमामपि च ते बालामनाथां परिभूय माम्। अनर्हाः प्रार्थयिष्यन्ति शूद्रा वेदश्रुतिं यथा॥१६॥
verses.english: When I shall be in such helpless state, the unworthy persons will demand this orphan girl, like Shudras desiring to hear the Vedas.

verses.sanskrit: तां चेदहं न दित्सेयं त्वद्गुणैरुपबृंहिताम्। प्रमथ्यैनां हरेयुस्ते हविर्ध्वाङ्क्षा इवाध्वरात्॥१७॥
verses.english: If I do not bestow this girl, endued with all qualities and possessing your blood, they may take her away by force as cows take the sacrificial ghee.

verses.sanskrit: संप्रेक्षमाणा पुत्रं ते नानुरूपमिवात्मनः। अनर्हवशमापन्नामिमां चापि सुतां तव॥१८॥
verses.english: Seeing your son (thoroughly) unlike yourself and your daughter under the control of unworthy person. I shall be despised in the world. I do not know what will happen to me. O Brahmana, there is no doubt I shall certainly die.

verses.sanskrit: अवज्ञाता च लोकेषु तथान्मानमजानती। अवलिप्तैरैर्ब्रह्मन्मरिष्यामि न संशयः॥१९॥
तौ च हीनौ मया बालौ त्वया चैव तथात्मजौ। विनश्येतां न सन्देहो मत्स्याविव जलक्षये॥२०॥
verses.english: There is no doubt these children of tender years, being bereft of me and you, will die as fish (in a tank) when the water is dried up.

verses.sanskrit: त्रितयं सर्वथाप्येवं विनशिष्यत्यसंशयम्। त्वया विहीनं तस्मात्त्वं मां परित्यक्तुमर्हसि॥२१॥
verses.english: There is no doubt the three (myself, our son and daughter) will all die without you. Therefore you ought to abandon me.

verses.sanskrit: व्युष्टिरेषा परा स्त्रीणां पूर्वं भर्तुः परां गतिम्। गन्तुं ब्रह्मन्सपुत्राणामिति धर्मविदो विदुः॥२२॥
verses.english: O Brahmana, persons learned in the precepts of virtue have said that to predecease their husbands in an act of the highest merit for women who have borne children.

verses.sanskrit: परित्यक्तः सुतश्चायं दुहितेयं तथा मया। बान्धवाश्च परित्यक्तास्त्वदर्थं जीवितं च मे॥२३॥
verses.english: I am ready to abandon this son and this daughter, these my relations, my this life itself.
verses.bhavadeepa: पराव्युष्टिर्महद्भाग्यम् । ‘व्युष्टिः फले समृद्धौ स्त्री’ इति मेदिनी ॥२२॥

verses.sanskrit: यज्ञैस्तपोभिर्नियमैर्दानैश्च विविधैस्तथा। विशिष्यते स्त्रिया भर्तुर्नित्यं प्रियहिते स्थितिः॥२४॥
verses.english: To be ever engaged in serving her husband is a higher duty to a women than sacrifices, asceticism, vows and various charities.

verses.sanskrit: तदिदं यच्चिकीर्षामि धर्मं परमसंमतम्। इष्टं चैव हितं चैव तव चैव कुलस्य च॥२५॥
verses.english: Therefore the act I desire to perform is consonant with the highest virtue. It is for your good and for the good of your race.

verses.sanskrit: इष्टानि चाप्यपत्यानि द्रव्याणि सुहृदः प्रियाः। आपद्धर्मप्रमोक्षाय भार्या चापि सतां मतम्॥२६॥
verses.english: The virtuous (men) say, that children, relatives, wives and all things dear in this world) are cherished for rescuing oneself from distress.

verses.sanskrit: आपदर्थे धनं रक्षेद्दारान्रक्षेद्धनैरपि। आत्मानं सततं रक्षेद्दारैरपि धनैरपि॥२७॥
verses.english: Man cherishes wealth for (rescuing himself) from distress and danger. By wealth be cherishes his wife. He must always cherish himself both by his wealth and wife.

verses.sanskrit: दृष्टादृष्टफलार्थं हि भार्या पुत्रो धनं गृहम्। सर्वमेतद्विधातव्यं बुधानामेष निश्चयः॥२८॥
verses.english: The wise men have said that wife, son, wealth or house is acquired to provide for foreseen or unforescen accidents.

verses.sanskrit: एकतो वा कुलं कृत्स्नमात्मा वा कुलवर्धनः। न समं सर्वमेवेति बुधानामेष निश्चयः॥२९॥
verses.english: The wise men have said that one's all relations, weighed against one's own self, would not be equal to one's own self.

verses.sanskrit: स कुरुष्व मया कार्यं तारयात्मानमात्मना। अनुजानीही मामार्य सुतौ मे परिपालय॥३०॥
verses.english: Therefore, O respected Sir, accomplish your object by me. Protect yourself by abandoning me. Give me your permission cherish children.
verses.bhavadeepa: आत्मना समं सर्वं नेति एष बुधानां निश्चयः ॥२९॥

verses.sanskrit: अवध्यां स्त्रियमित्याहुर्धर्मज्ञा धर्मनिश्चये। धर्मज्ञान्राक्षसानाहुर्न हन्यात्स च मामपि॥३१॥
verses.english: In fixing moralities the men, learned in the precepts of virtue, have said that women should never be killed; and (they have also said that the Rakshasas are learned in the rules of morality. Therefore he (the Rakshasas) may not kill me.

verses.sanskrit: निःसंशयं वधः पुंसां स्त्रीणां संशयितो वधः। अतो मामेव धर्मज्ञ प्रस्थापयितुमर्हसि॥३२॥
verses.english: It is certain that he will kill a man, but it is doubtful whether he will kill a woman. O virtuously learned man, you ought to send me.

verses.sanskrit: भुक्तं प्रियाण्यवाप्तानि धर्मश्च चरितो मया। त्वत्प्रसूतिः प्रिया प्राप्ता न मां तप्स्यत्यजीवितम्॥३३॥
verses.english: I have enjoyed much happiness; I have obtained many things agreeable; I have earned much of religious merits; I have obtained from you beloved sons; I do not grieve to die.

verses.sanskrit: जातपुत्रा च वृद्धा च प्रियकामा च ते सदा। समीक्ष्यैतदहं सर्वं व्यवसायं करोम्यतः॥३४॥
verses.english: I have borne son and I have grown old; I am ever desirous of doing good to you. Having considered all this, I have come to this resolution.
verses.bhavadeepa: त्वत् त्वत्तः प्रसूतिः सन्ततिः अजीवितं मरणम् ॥३३॥

verses.sanskrit: उत्सृज्यापि हि मामार्य प्राप्स्यस्यन्यामपि स्त्रियम्। ततः प्रतिष्ठितो धर्मो भविष्यति पुनस्तव॥३५॥
verses.english: O respected Sir, you can take another wife by abandoning me. You may be then again placed on the path of virtue.

verses.sanskrit: न चाप्यधर्मः कल्याण बहुपत्नीकतां नृणाम्। स्त्रीणामधर्मः सुमहान्भर्तुः पूर्वस्य लङ्घने॥३६॥
verses.english: To marry more than one wife is not sin among men. It is very sinful for a woman to take second husband after the first.

verses.sanskrit: एतत्सर्वं समीक्ष्य त्वमात्मत्यागं च गर्हितम्। आत्मानं तारयाद्याशु कुलं चेमौ च दारकौ॥३७॥
verses.english: Having considered all this and knowing that your self-sacrifice is censurable, save today yourself, your race and your these two children without loss of time.

verses.sanskrit:
वैशंपायन उवाच।
              एवमुक्तस्तया भर्ता तां समालिङ्ग्य भारत। मुमोच बाष्पं शनकैः सभार्यो भृशदुःखितः॥३८॥
verses.english: O foremost of the Bharata race, when Brahmani told thus, her husband became griefstricken and, embracing her, shed copious tears along with her.
